children: Lean hog futures on the CME settle up 0.4% to 74.3 cents a pound, turning around after settling lower on Tuesday. Hog futures have been gradually positioning themselves for a turnaround, says the Hightower Report in a note. "Speculators can look to buy a pullback on October hogs," says the firm. Hog futures finished higher in three of the past four sessions, according to FactSet data. Live cattle futures settle down 0.6% to $2.121 a pound. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
